---
title: "disease-surveillance-workshop"
---

Contains all material for the disease surveillance workshops, including code and data.

https://siobhonlegan.com/disease-surveillance-workshop

## How to download

### 1. Follow the link

Simply click on [this link](https://github.com/siobhon-egan/disease-surveillance-workshop/archive/refs/heads/master.zip) to download a zipped file and unzip.

### 2. Download in your brower from github

https://github.com/siobhon-egan/disease-surveillance-workshop

Click on the green `code` button and click `Download ZIP`.
Unzip file on your computer.

### 3. From the terminal

```bash
git clone https://github.com/siobhon-egan/disease-surveillance-workshop
```


## How to use

Open the `disease-surveillance-workshop.Rproj` file and it will open a new session in RStudio.

To follow along simply open the lesson file e.g. `mapping.qmd` and you can execute the commands.
All relevent data is stored in the `data` directory.
